sentences.text: The training chart’s scales divide each minute into tenths, so positions are written in degrees, minutes and tenths of a minute: forty-one degrees, eighteen point five minutes means eighteen and a half minutes.
Don’t confuse that with eighteen minutes, fifty seconds, an older format.
Count the small tick marks carefully, since scales at different latitudes may be divided differently.
Always write latitude first, with north or south, then longitude, with east or west.
